value.rationale: Applications select a single fixed three-mer priority ranking across changing scanner window sizes. Scalar optimum densities do not tell whether one ranking works across configurations. This exact sharp two-point tradeoff identifies the first shared-order obstruction and every undominated quantitative compromise, a natural complete design decision rather than an arbitrary enumerated slice.
